name: Claudia Doumit
bio: Claudia Doumit (born April 21, 1992) is an Australian actress of Lebanese and Italian ancestry. She is best known for role in Prime Video television series The Boys (2019–2026) and its spinoff series Gen V (2023–2025), as well as starring in the NBC series Timeless (2016–2018).
